title: RAW UNREVIEWED: an instrument diagram with independently named operations
summary: Search public primary witnesses for a diagram whose parts have diplomatic names and whose accompanying prose directs a complete ordered operation using those parts. First bind source names, part ownership, and action order without target text. Only an admitted target diagram with genuinely matching part topology and operation capacity could enter a whole-reading comparison; one pictorial resemblance would not select words. No such matching witness is asserted.

design.mechanism: historical part labels and written action order jointly key noun and verb roles
design.unit: whole source diagram and instruction with complete target diagram and prose
design.contrast: ordered part-action account versus unordered diagram-label analogy
design.prediction: a frozen reading assigns the same complete forms to independently owned parts and explains every directed operation in source order
